methodology.goal: Freeze the smallest useful new-family follow-through batch for the accepted v1 band heuristic, while preserving high/middle/low controls.
methodology.selection_basis: Families are banded by the accepted formula and sampled deterministically within each band. Previous paid-pilot families are excluded by default so the next spend increases coverage instead of duplicating rows.

Generate the same slot contract for all arms if approved.
Admit outputs and compare improvement by arm before broad language-wide spending.

generation_contract.evaluation_rule: Apply generated evidence to every arm under the same selected candidate policies, then compare improvement for high_need versus middle_control and low_control. Do not tune thresholds from the generated rows.
